questions.solution_text:
$(x + 1)(x - 7)^2 > 0$
Critical values: $x = -1$ (multiplicity $1$) and $x = 7$ (multiplicity $2$).
Since $(x - 7)^2 > 0$ for all $x \neq 7$, $x + 1 > 0 \implies x > -1$.
Excluding $x = 7$ gives $-1 < x < 7$ or $x > 7$.

questions.solution_text:
$(x - 2)(x + 6)^2 \le 0$
Critical values: $x = -6$ (multiplicity $2$) and $x = 2$ (multiplicity $1$).
Since $(x + 6)^2 \ge 0$, $P(x) \le 0$ requires $x - 2 \le 0 \implies x \le 2$.
$x \le 2$
